heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Board
tree.text: The term “Board” means the Board of Directors of the Foundation.

tree.heading: Bureau
tree.text: The term “Bureau” means the Office of Justice Services of the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

tree.heading: Committee
tree.text: The term “Committee” means the Committee for the Establishment of the Indian Law Enforcement Foundation established under section 5412(e)(1) of this title.

tree.heading: Foundation
tree.text: The term “Foundation” means the Indian Law Enforcement Foundation established under section 5412 of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 458ccc of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 93–638, title VII, § 701, as added Pub. L. 111–211, title II, § 231(c), July 29, 2010, 124 Stat. 2274.)
